supported_travel.title: Move the harness trolley
supported_travel.caption: Move the trolley carrying the harness and training dummy along the ceiling support track. Pass the halfway point and continue until the dummy is 2 m from its starting position. Release the trolley and leave it still with the dummy supported by the harness. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.

bar_height_lock.title: Set and lock the bar height
bar_height_lock.caption: On the parallel bars, use the rail closest to the floor mat. Withdraw its locking pin, raise that rail 12 cm, then reinsert the pin. Press down on the rail to check that it holds its new height. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

board_transfer_setup.title: Position the transfer board
board_transfer_setup.caption: Park the wheelchair beside the plinth and engage both brakes. Lift the armrest on the plinth side and swing the footrests and footplates clear. Raise the plinth, then lift the transfer board from its top and lay it across the gap with one end on the wheelchair seat and the other on the plinth. Release the board and press down to check that both ends stay supported. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.

powered_plinth.title: Adjust the powered plinth
powered_plinth.caption: Facing the pair of foot pedals on the loaded plinth beside the wheelchair, press the left pedal to raise the top 12 cm above its starting height. Release it and let the top hold. Press the right pedal to lower the top to 3 cm above its starting height, then release it and let the top hold again. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

trainer_reach.title: Adjust the pedal trainer seat
trainer_reach.caption: Withdraw the locking pin below the pedal trainer’s seat. Slide the seat 8 cm along its adjustment rail, away from the pedals. Reinsert the pin, then push on the seat to check that it stays in place. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

move_ramp.title: Move ramp
move_ramp.caption: Slide the entire ramp lengthwise toward the training stairs. Move it halfway first, then continue until it is 35 cm from its starting position. Release the ramp and leave it upright and still. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

kitchen_access.title: Use the accessible kitchen
kitchen_access.caption: Face the kitchen cabinet and open the left of the two doors directly beneath the cutlery drawer. With that door open, pull the drawer out 30 cm. Push the drawer fully back in, then close the door and leave both still. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

washer_inspection.title: Inspect the washer
washer_inspection.caption: At the washing machine beside the dryer, open the front door and turn the empty drum half a turn by hand. Close the door and leave both the door and the drum still. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.
